q: How should a Sangli sugar mill distillery count methane from spentwash digesters?
title: Sangli distillery spentwash methane
short: Biogas burnt in the boiler gives biogenic CO2, reported separately, but methane that escapes from digesters, leaks or open lagoons counts in Scope 1 at its full warming effect. Measure biogas produced and burnt; the gap, plus any flaring losses, is where the Scope 1 methane is.
audience: Sugar mills with molasses distilleries in Sangli and western Maharashtra

ul: Open lagoons holding spentwash before treatment.

p: Biogas flow meters on the digester outlet and boiler inlet give the gap. For open lagoons, use IPCC wastewater methods based on chemical oxygen demand, labelled as estimates.
Capturing biogas that replaces coal in the boiler cuts fossil Scope 1, and well-run digesters may support offset projects under approved methodologies.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a figure can be traced to its source.
